sections.heading: MINOR IN CLASSICAL STUDIES
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Classical Studies
Completion of first-year requirements. Classical Studies 1000 is recommended.
1.0 designated essay course in Classical Studies at the 2000 level or above.
3.0 courses in Classical Studies at the 2000 level or above.

A maximum of 2.0 courses may be substituted for the courses in the last two items above from: Art History 3610F/G, Philosophy 2200F/G, Philosophy 3002F/G, Philosophy 3003F/G, Philosophy 3005F/G, Philosophy 3006F/G, Philosophy 3007F/G, Philosophy 3008F/G, Philosophy 4007F/G, Philosophy 4015F/G, Philosophy 4016F/G, Philosophy 4017F/G.
Appropriate course substitutions, including Special Topics courses, may be made with the permission of Department.
